name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-stooge-sort
code:
use default

stooge_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](
    values: LIST[T], low: int, high: int
) is
    if values[high] < values[low] then
        (values[low], values[high]) = (values[high], values[low])
    fi

    if high - low > 1 then
        let third = (high - low + 1) / 3

        stooge_sort(values, low, high - third)
        stooge_sort(values, low + third, high)
        stooge_sort(values, low, high - third)
    fi
si

stooge_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    stooge_sort(values, 0, values.count - 1)
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

stooge_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

stooge_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
